archetype: Warm Hospitality & Performance Pro (Organic Warmth + Tactical Precision)
design_direction: Warm, hospitality-inspired. Tactile, premium editorial feel reminiscent of high-end dining menu craftsmanship combined with a high-density, action-oriented operator dashboard.

persona.name: jhax
persona.role: Restaurant COO & Strategic Co-Pilot (15+ Years Experience)
persona.tone: Direct, commercially savvy, warm, data-driven, confident, zero corporate fluff, plain-spoken, actionable.

headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1E1B18]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1E1B18]

layout_architecture.header: Sticky Glassmorphic Header (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF8F5]/90 border-b border-[#E8DEC8]) featuring active restaurant quick-switcher, location pin, live market status pill, and reset/add buttons.
layout_architecture.left_sidebar: Restaurant Profile & Market Snapshot Panel (collapsible on mobile). Displays cuisine type, price tier, rating, active local context (events, weather impact, nearby competitor moves), and top menu margin drivers.
layout_architecture.center_main: Jhax Co-Pilot Chat Engine & Rich Canvas. Features auto-started Restaurant Snapshot, step-by-step COO reasoning accordion, formatted markdown tables, copy-paste caption generators, execution checklists, and quick prompt chips.
layout_architecture.right_panel: Action & Execution Drawer (Calculators, Marketing Drafts, Menu Re-engineering Canvas, Staff Briefing Notes).

component_guidelines.RestaurantSelector: Interactive quick-picker with sample benchmark restaurants (e.g. 'Osteria Rustica - Italian Fine Casual', 'The Smoked Barrel - BBQ & Craft Taphouse', 'Green Sprout - Plant-based Fast Casual') + custom entry modal with input for restaurant name, city/neighborhood, and cuisine.
component_guidelines.ResearchingState: Tactile data-gathering state showing live steps ('Scraping current menu & pricing...', 'Analyzing Yelp & Google Reviews sentiment...', 'Checking local events & weather forecasts...', 'Running competitor benchmarking...').
component_guidelines.SnapshotCard: Auto-triggered first AI message. Styled as an executive brief on parchment background with gold accent border, key KPIs, competitor radar, neighborhood opportunity, and immediate quick-win recommendation.
component_guidelines.ChatInterface: Rich markdown renderer with custom code/draft boxes featuring instant copy button, interactive checkboxes for execution steps, metric pill badges, and 3-5 high-impact follow-up question chips.
component_guidelines.PromptChips: Horizontal scrollable chip bar with categories like 'Food Cost Reduction', 'Weekend Promotion', 'Menu Re-pricing', 'Staff Retention', 'Social Caption Draft'.
component_guidelines.DraftBox: Copy-paste ready box with one-click 'Copy to Clipboard', 'Tweak Tone', and 'Export as PDF/Print' triggers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a seamless, high-polished single-page React app (with backend FastAPI endpoints if needed or mock API handler) that requires NO login.
Initial landing view allows user to pick a sample restaurant (e.g. Osteria Rustica, Smoked Barrel BBQ, Green Sprout, etc.) or type their own restaurant name + location.

Upon selecting/submitting, transition into an immersive 3-step animated data-gathering state ('Analyzing menu price elasticities...', 'Scanning local competitor promotions...', 'Gathering sentiment from 420+ online reviews...').

Auto-trigger jhax's initial message with a beautifully crafted 'Restaurant Snapshot' executive summary (market position, benchmark ratings, 3 key strengths, 2 vulnerabilities, and 1 high-impact non-obvious opportunity).

Provide interactive quick prompt chips below the chat box (e.g., 'How can I bump my prime cost down 3%?', 'Draft an Instagram caption for Friday's chef special', 'Analyze my weekend brunch vs competitors', 'Give me a 5-step staff incentive plan').

Ensure jhax responses include a collapsible 'jhax Reasoning Process' section (demonstrating 15-year COO logic), clear execution steps with interactive checkboxes, quantitative data tables, and dedicated copy-paste boxes for draft content.
Include a dynamic right-hand panel or tab view with interactive tools: Prime Cost Calculator, Menu Engineering Matrix (Star/Plowhorse/Puzzle/Dog), and Social Caption Studio.

Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all key interactive elements (e.g. `restaurant-select-option`, `search-restaurant-input`, `start-copilot-button`, `chat-send-button`, `copy-draft-button`, `prompt-chip`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic blue/purple SaaS templates. Stick strictly to warm ivory, sandstone, warm brass amber, and dark espresso accents.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) with subtle warm borders (border-[#E8DEC8]) to create tactile, premium restaurant menu elegance.
Ensure every chat response has clear actionable value: clear numbers, copyable content, step-by-step checklists.
All buttons must have distinct hover states with smooth CSS transitions (`transition-colors duration-200`).
Ensure high accessibility and contrast compliance.
